hook: A modified arrestin1 slowed retinal degeneration in three different mouse models of inherited blindness
summary: Many genes cause inherited retinal disease, so the authors tested a gene-independent fix that boosts glycolysis, the sugar-burning pathway, in photoreceptors. Treated mice kept more retinal function and structure in models of rod, cone and pigment-layer degeneration. The results are from mice and describe slowing, not stopping, the damage; the abstract gives no human data.
title: A modified Arrestin1 Slows Retinal Degeneration Across Genetically Distinct Mouse Models of Inherited Retinal Disease
